name: alternate_phone_number comment: 备用电话号码(中东预留) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_line1 comment: 地址行1(街道) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: place_id comment: Google Place ID constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: latitude comment: 纬度 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_order comment: 字段顺序(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_labels comment: 字段标签(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_type comment: 规则类型(pattern/length/custom) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 执行优先级(值小先执行) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pattern comment: 正则表达式(pattern/custom时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: min_length comment: 最小长度(length时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: max_length comment: 最大长度(length时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message comment: 错误提示文案 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message_i18n_key comment: 多语言key(预留) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: administrative_division comment: 行政区划层级 note: 各国行政区划树形数据(州/市/区)，支撑下拉选择 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: level comment: 层级(1=州/省 2=市 3=区) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code comment: 行政区划代码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: parent_id comment: 父级ID(自引用) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code_mapping comment: 邮编映射表 note: 邮编→城市/州反查(V1.1预留) columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code comment: 邮政编码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: city comment: 城市 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: state_code comment: 州/省代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user comment: 用户(外部) note: 用户模块提供，地址库引用user_id columns: - name: id comment: 用户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: email comment: 邮箱 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 账户状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country comment: 国家(market模块) note: MARKET模块提供，地址库引用country_code columns: - name: country_code comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 国家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: user to: address type: 1:N label: 拥有多个地址 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: country to: address type: 1:N label: 地址所属国家 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: country_address_config type: '1:1' label: 国家字段配置 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: 校验规则(多规则) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: postal_code_mapping type: 1:N label: 邮编数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 行政区划数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: administrative_division to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 父子层级(自引用) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed design_rules: superset_fields: 超集字段设计：数据库包含所有国家字段，通过country_address_config控制展示 market_integration: 国家可用性引用market模块，地址库不独立维护国家列表 frontend_i18n: 前端多语言采用i18n方案，数据库不存储多语言字段 name_split: recipient_first_name + recipient_last_name 拆分存储，支持支付AVS和物流API name_concat: recipient_name 冗余存储拼接结果，拼接顺序由country_address_config.name_format控制 address_type_enum: 'address_type 枚举值: shipping, billing' verified_source_enum: 'verified_source 枚举值: google, usps, loqate' soft_delete: 地址数据支持软删除(CCPA要求可彻底删除) encryption: phone_number, recipient_first_name, recipient_last_name 字段 AES-256 加密存储 place_id_dedup: 通过 place_id 做地址去重(V1.1) mvp_scope: 'MVP只启用美国(US)，预留字段: alternate_phone_*, district, building_name, verified_*' snapshot_ownership: 订单地址快照(order_address_snapshot)由订单模块管理，不在地址库ER图中体现 backend_validation: V1.2新增：address_field_validation_rules表存储后端校验规则，防止XSS/SQL注入/路径遍历攻击 multi_rule_validation: V1.3重构：同一字段支持多条校验规则，按priority顺序执行，命中首个失败即返回对应error_message rule_type_enum: 'rule_type 枚举值: pattern(正则格式), length(长度范围), custom(自定义正则)。必填性不在此表' required_level_ownership: 必填性(required/optional/hidden)由country_address_config.field_config统一管理，后端校验时先读config判断必填，再跑validation_rules的格式/长度规则 field_config_structure: 'field_config JSON结构: {field_name: {required_level: "required"|"optional"|"hidden", visible: bool}}'
